title: Choose the visual world for your portfolio
question: The roll assigned The Preprint. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Preprint (arXiv paper)
options.lineage: arXiv abstract pages + LaTeX two-column papers
options.thesis: Your portfolio typeset as a paper: 'Student Again: a 14-year longitudinal study of one data engineer'.
options.viewport: Title, authors with affiliations (IIT Jodhpur, 3M), abstract, and live Figure 1: your career curve with a version slider v1 (2012) to v15 (2026).
options.risk: Can read academic and dry if the figures are timid; handwriting-free, so personality must come from the copy.

raised.raise: Rewind re-typesets the paper in place. No modal: the paper itself is the instrument.
Every number carries a citation [n] stitched to its real source in the References.
Figure 1 is one continuous career line; reconstructed model answers set in hairline, facts in solid.

options.label: The 2012 Executive Dashboard
options.lineage: SAP BusinessObjects / Xcelsius iPad dashboards you built at TCS
options.thesis: Your career as the KPI dashboard you used to build: gauges, a time slicer, drill-down tiles.
options.viewport: A single dashboard canvas: KPIs ($1M saved, 60K users, 14 yrs) as gauges, the Rewind as the dashboard's year slicer.
options.risk: The most familiar form for a data person; dashboards are where many 'data portfolio' entries land.

options.label: The Mixtape J-card
options.lineage: hand-lettered cassette inlays, side A / side B
options.thesis: Side A: Data (2012-2024). Side B: AI, student again (2025-). Press rewind and the tape runs back to 2012.
options.viewport: Folded J-card: spine with your name, front flap headline, tracklist of career eras with running times; a tape deck with a working REWIND key.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: Side A / Side B states your pivot in two words, and 'rewind' is native to the form. Beats the Preprint on recognisability and clarity.
options.risk: Nostalgic novelty if the deck is a costume; handwriting must stay for headings only so body text reads.

options.label: Time Circuits (seven-segment)
options.lineage: seven-segment clocks, scoreboards, the movie time-machine dashboard
options.thesis: Destination time / present time panels: dial in 2012 and the whole display re-lights that year.
options.viewport: Three stacked LED panels (DESTINATION / PRESENT / LAST DEPARTED) over your name; your metrics as scoreboard digits.
options.case: Very memorable and native to 'time machine', but long career text in a digit world loses clarity.
options.risk: Literal time-machine reading; body copy needs a second face to stay readable.

options.label: Swiss Poster Wall
options.thesis: Each career era is one poster on a single grid; rewind re-sorts the wall.
options.viewport: Wall of 6 era posters, the current one large; red bar marks the active year.
options.case: Holds clarity and judges read it as 'designed', but nothing in it is uniquely you.
options.risk: Close to the category standard; personality depends entirely on copy.

options.label: Ebru marbling bath
options.thesis: Navigation as stirring a liquid surface.
options.viewport: Full-bleed bath, career eras as pigment drops.
options.case: Fuses poorly: judges and recruiters do not read a data/AI career in it.
options.risk: Beautiful but tells nobody what you do.
options.kept: One surface acted on in place: Rewind changes the page itself, never opens a modal.

options.label: Memory quilt
options.thesis: Each era a patch with its own history.
options.case: Fuses poorly: domestic register undersells enterprise impact.
options.kept: Every claim seamed to its source: each metric cites the real award or resume line.

options.label: Provenance ribbon
options.thesis: One ribbon through every owner of an object.
options.viewport: A vertical ribbon with dated folds.
options.case: Fuses partly, but archival buff lands on the cream default and reads museum, not AI.
options.kept: One continuous line through every era, with known facts solid and reconstructions hairline.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio: hero, skills grid, project cards, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and title, short intro, CTA buttons; Rewind sits as a section below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from most entries by design; creativity score rests only on the feature.
